name: revit_get_model_info
description: Get the name, path, and active view of the currently open Revit document.

name: revit_create_wall
description: Create a new wall in Revit given start point, end point, level, height, and optionally a wall type.

name: revit_create_line_based_element
description: Create a line-based element such as a beam, brace, or structural framing member.

name: revit_create_point_based_element
description: Create a point-based element such as a door, window, furniture, or fixture at a specific location.

name: revit_create_floor
description: Create a floor element from boundary points on a specific level.

name: revit_create_ceiling
description: Create a ceiling element from boundary points on a specific level.

name: revit_create_roof
description: Create a roof element from a footprint on a specific level.

name: revit_create_level
description: Create a new level at a specified elevation.

name: revit_create_grid
description: Create a grid line from a start point to an end point.

name: revit_create_room
description: Place a room at a specific location on a level. The room will automatically detect its boundaries from surrounding walls.

name: revit_create_sheet
description: Create a new sheet in the Revit project.

name: revit_create_view
description: Create a new view in the Revit project.

name: revit_create_schedule
description: Create a new schedule/quantity takeoff in the Revit project.

name: revit_create_tag
description: Create a tag annotation for an element in the current view.

name: revit_create_dimension
description: Create a dimension annotation between two points or references in the current view.

name: revit_create_text_note
description: Create a text note annotation in the current view.

name: revit_modify_parameter
description: Set or modify a parameter value on a Revit element.

name: revit_move_element
description: Move a Revit element by a translation vector (deltaX, deltaY, deltaZ).

name: revit_rotate_element
description: Rotate a Revit element around a point by a specified angle.

name: revit_copy_element
description: Copy a Revit element to a new location.

name: revit_delete_elements
description: Delete one or more elements from the Revit model by their IDs.

name: revit_mirror_element
description: Mirror a Revit element across a line defined by two points.

name: revit_align_elements
description: Align multiple elements to a reference element or position.

name: revit_group_elements
description: Create a group from multiple elements.

name: revit_change_type
description: Change the type of an element (e.g. change a wall from one type to another).

name: revit_set_workset
description: Move elements to a different workset (for workshared projects).

name: revit_color_elements
description: Color elements in the current view based on a parameter value. Useful for visual analysis.

name: revit_batch_modify_parameters
description: Modify a parameter value on multiple elements at once.

name: revit_parameter_batch_editor
description: Rule-driven bulk parameter editing. Selects a scope (category, element IDs, current selection), keeps only elements matching 'where' conditions, then applies each 'set' edit — a literal value, a regex find/replace on the existing value, or a copy from another parameter. Example: where Category=Walls and Height > 3 m, set 'Fire Rating' = '2h'. Run with dryRun: true first to preview which elements change.

name: revit_get_current_view_info
description: Get detailed information about the currently active Revit view, including view type, name, scale, and properties.

name: revit_get_current_view_elements
description: Get all elements visible in the current Revit view. Optionally filter by category. Supports pagination via offset/limit — response includes totalCount and hasMore to know if more batches are needed.

name: revit_get_selected_elements
description: Get details of all currently selected elements in Revit, including their IDs, categories, and parameters.

name: revit_get_elements
description: Get all elements of a specific category from the Revit model. Response includes totalCount (total matching elements) and hasMore (if paginated). Use offset/limit for large datasets — default returns all elements.

name: revit_get_structural_framing_geometry
description: Get start/end points (in Revit's internal decimal-feet units), material, and family/type name for every element in "Structural Framing" (beams/braces) or "Structural Columns" — the data source for the bimazim_sync_revit_to_structural bridge tool. Points are NOT converted to any other unit system; the caller converts feet to whatever units the target structural-analysis engine's model uses.

name: revit_get_parameters
description: Get all parameters (instance and type) for a specific element by its ID.

name: revit_get_project_info
description: Get general project information including project name, number, address, client, status, and other metadata.

name: revit_get_views
description: Get a list of all views in the Revit project. Optionally filter by view type. Supports aliases: '3D' (ThreeD), 'Plan' (FloorPlan), 'RCP' (CeilingPlan), 'Ceiling', 'Drafting' (DraftingView), 'Area' (AreaPlan).

name: revit_get_sheets
description: Get all sheets in the Revit project, including sheet name, number, and placed views.

name: revit_get_levels
description: Get all levels in the Revit project with their names and elevations.

name: revit_get_grids
description: Get all grids in the Revit project with their names, directions, and positions.

name: revit_get_rooms
description: Get all rooms in the Revit project with their names, numbers, areas, and boundary information.

name: revit_get_families
description: Get available family types in the Revit project. Optionally filter by category.

name: revit_get_schedules
description: Get all schedules in the Revit project with their names, fields, and data.

name: revit_get_linked_models
description: Get information about all linked Revit models in the current project.

name: revit_get_link_info
description: Get detailed information about linked Revit models: load status, file path, instance count, and linked file status.

name: revit_unload_links
description: Unload linked Revit models to reduce memory and improve performance. Optionally filter by name.

name: revit_get_warnings
description: Get all active warnings/errors in the Revit model for quality control.

name: revit_open_view
description: Open a specific view in the Revit UI so the user can see it.

name: revit_close_view
description: Close a specific view in the Revit UI.

name: revit_open_document
description: Open a .rvt Revit file. Optionally detach from central.

name: revit_create_new_project
description: Create a new Revit project. Optionally specify a template file.

name: revit_create_new_family
description: Create a new family (.rfa) from a template. Opens the family editor.

name: revit_detach_from_central
description: Open a workshared .rvt file detached from its central model.

name: revit_change_link_path
description: Change the file path of a linked Revit model. Useful when links are broken or moved.

name: revit_manage_link_position
description: Move or rotate a linked model instance in the project.

name: revit_zoom_to_fit
description: Zoom the active view to fit all visible content. Equivalent to pressing 'ZF' in Revit.

name: revit_zoom_to_element
description: Zoom the active view to center on a specific element with padding.

name: revit_edit_schedule
description: Edit a schedule's structure: add/remove fields, sort, toggle itemization, show/hide headers. Use action='info' to get field details first.

name: revit_create_stairs
description: Create stairs between two levels by defining location, width, and stair configuration.

name: revit_create_railing
description: Create a railing along a path or attached to stairs.

name: revit_create_curtain_wall
description: Create a curtain wall with configurable grid pattern.

name: revit_create_filled_region
description: Create a filled region in a view from boundary points.

name: revit_create_elevation_views
description: Create elevation views facing a room or area.

name: revit_create_section_views
description: Create section views through elements or at specified locations.

name: revit_create_spot_elevation
description: Create a spot elevation annotation in the current view.

name: revit_send_code_to_revit
description: Send C# code to execute directly in Revit. The code runs in the context of the Revit API with access to the current Document and UIApplication. Use for advanced operations not covered by other tools.

name: revit_reset_view
description: Reset the current view to default settings (zoom extents, clear overrides).

name: revit_select_elements
description: Select specific elements in Revit by their IDs.

name: revit_get_model_statistics
description: Get comprehensive model statistics: element counts by category, total elements, file size, warnings count, etc.

name: revit_auto_join_elements
description: Automatically join geometry between two categories (e.g. Walls↔Floors, Walls↔Columns). Processes all intersecting elements.

name: revit_reassign_level
description: Move elements to a different level while preserving their vertical position (offset adjustment).

name: revit_batch_modify_thickness
description: Modify wall or slab thickness by scaling compound structure layers proportionally.

name: revit_room_to_floor
description: Generate floor elements from room boundaries. Creates one floor per room using the room's boundary curves.

name: revit_find_replace_names
description: Global find-and-replace in element type names, view names, or sheet names.

name: revit_parameter_case_convert
description: Convert a text parameter's value to UPPER, lower, or Title case for all elements in a category.

name: revit_bulk_parameter_transfer
description: Copy values from one parameter to another for all elements in a category (e.g. sync Comments to Mark).

name: revit_auto_renumber
description: Sequentially renumber elements (rooms, doors, etc.) sorted by location or name.

name: revit_batch_create_sheets
description: Create multiple sheets at once from a list of sheet numbers and names.

name: revit_align_viewports
description: Align all viewports on a sheet horizontally, vertically, or to the same center.

name: revit_deep_purge
description: Multi-pass deep purge of all unused elements (families, types, line styles, view filters, etc.).

name: revit_delete_empty_groups
description: Find and delete all empty groups and unused group types in the project.

name: revit_find_cad_imports
description: Locate all CAD imports in the project. Optionally delete non-linked imports.

name: revit_select_by_parameter
description: Select all elements where a specific parameter matches a value.

name: revit_select_by_workset
description: Select all elements on a specific workset.

name: revit_filter_selection
description: Filter the current selection to keep only elements matching a category and/or level.

name: revit_category_to_workset
description: Automatically migrate all elements of specified categories to designated worksets.

name: revit_inverse_selection
description: Invert the current selection — deselect what's selected and select everything else visible in the view.

name: revit_copy_from_linked
description: Copy elements from a linked Revit model into the current document.

name: revit_crop_region_sync
description: Copy the crop region from one master view to multiple target views.

name: revit_apply_view_template
description: Apply a view template to one or more views. Lists available templates if the specified one is not found.

name: revit_resolve_warnings
description: List or auto-resolve Revit warnings. Can fix duplicate marks, unenclosed rooms, and overlapping room separations.

name: revit_wall_floor_sync
description: Auto-join all walls and floors that intersect, ensuring proper boundary connections.

name: revit_snap_beams_to_columns
description: Snap beam endpoints to the nearest column centerlines. Fixes misaligned structural framing.

name: revit_convert_category
description: Convert elements to a different family/category. Deletes old elements and places new ones at the same location.

name: revit_add_shared_parameter
description: Inject a shared parameter into a Revit category. Creates the shared parameter file automatically if needed.

name: revit_generate_legend
description: Generate a door or window legend — creates a drafting view with a table listing all unique types, dimensions, and counts.

name: revit_cad_to_lines
description: Convert CAD imports to native Revit detail lines, arcs, and polylines. Optionally delete the CAD import after conversion.

name: revit_batch_get_parameters
description: Batch get parameters for elements.

name: revit_find_elements_by_parameter
description: Find elements by parameter value.

name: revit_audit_model_standards
description: Audit the active model against a JSON standard set (naming, required parameters, line weights, view templates, health, workset assignments, phase compliance, shared parameters). Returns a 0-100% compliance score and violation list with BEP clause references. Pass fix=true to auto-apply safe fixes in one transaction. Pass exportBaseline=true to export the current model's config as a reusable standard. Uses the built-in BIM-Bot standard unless `standards`, `standardsPath`, or `standardsUrl` is given.

name: revit_check_warnings
description: Get all active warnings in the Revit model. Useful for model cleanup and quality control.

name: revit_audit_model
description: Perform a comprehensive model audit: check for orphaned elements, unused families, missing views on sheets, etc.

name: revit_check_room_compliance
description: Check rooms for compliance: minimum area requirements, accessibility, proper naming, and boundary closure.

name: revit_check_naming_conventions
description: Verify that views, sheets, and families follow naming conventions (regex pattern matching).

name: revit_find_duplicates
description: Find duplicate elements in the model (overlapping walls, duplicate rooms, etc.).

name: revit_purge_unused
description: Find and optionally purge unused families, types, and materials from the model.

name: revit_check_links_status
description: Check the status of all linked models (loaded, unloaded, missing).

name: revit_validate_parameters
description: Validate that required parameters are filled in for elements of a specific category.

name: revit_validate_shared_coordinates
description: Check if all linked models share the same shared coordinate system as the host or a master link. Reports per-link offsets (X, Y, Z in mm) and rotation angle. Optionally acquires coordinates from a master link to fix misalignment.

name: revit_create_duct
description: Create a duct segment between two points. Specify duct type and size.

name: revit_create_pipe
description: Create a pipe segment between two points. Specify pipe type and diameter.

name: revit_create_flex_duct
description: Create a flexible duct from a series of waypoints.

name: revit_create_electrical_circuit
description: Create an electrical circuit from a panel and connected device element IDs.

name: revit_connect_mep_elements
description: Auto-connect two MEP elements by generating appropriate fittings (elbows, tees, transitions).

name: revit_get_mep_systems
description: Get all MEP systems in the project (duct, pipe, electrical) with element counts and system info.

name: revit_duct_sizing
description: Auto-size ducts based on airflow requirements. Calculates optimal duct dimensions for a given CFM.

name: revit_create_mep_space
description: Create an MEP space at a specified location on a level for HVAC analysis.

name: revit_create_detail_lines
description: Draw detail lines in a drafting or plan view from an array of coordinate pairs. Supports polylines, rectangles, and free-form shapes.

name: revit_create_model_lines
description: Draw 3D model lines from an array of coordinate pairs. Lines exist in 3D space and are visible in all views.

name: revit_create_detail_arc
description: Draw a detail arc in a view. Defined by center point, radius, start angle, and end angle.

name: revit_save_document
description: Save the currently active Revit document. Equivalent to Ctrl+S.

name: revit_save_as_document
description: Save the active document to a new file path (.rvt). Creates a copy without closing the current document.

name: revit_close_document
description: Close the active Revit document. Optionally save before closing.

name: revit_edit_family
description: Open a family for editing. Takes an element ID of a family instance, opens the family document for editing.

name: revit_create_family_extrusion
description: Create a solid extrusion in the currently open family document. Defines a rectangular or polygonal profile and extrudes it.

name: revit_save_family
description: Save the currently open family document and optionally load it back into the project.

name: revit_load_family
description: Load a .rfa family file from disk into the current Revit project.

name: revit_sync_to_central
description: Synchronize the local model with the central model. Equivalent to Revit's 'Synchronize with Central' command.

name: revit_relinquish_all
description: Relinquish all borrowed elements and worksets without syncing. Frees up elements for other users.

name: revit_get_worksharing_info
description: Get current worksharing status: central model path, local changes, borrowed elements, workset ownership, and last sync time.

name: revit_modify_object_styles
description: Modify the default line weight and color for a Revit category (Object Styles). Affects all elements of that category in the project.

name: revit_set_phase
description: Assign a construction phase (e.g. Existing, New Construction, Demolition) to elements.

name: revit_get_phases
description: List all construction phases available in the Revit project.

name: revit_get_materials
description: List all materials available in the Revit project with their colors and transparency.

name: revit_set_material
description: Assign a material to elements. The material must already exist in the project.

name: revit_set_view_properties
description: Modify view settings such as scale, detail level, visual style, discipline, phase, name, and crop box. Works on the active view or a specific view by ID.

name: revit_override_element_in_view
description: Apply graphic overrides to specific elements in the current view. Can change color, line weight, transparency, halftone, or hide elements.

name: revit_get_line_styles
description: List all line styles available in the Revit project with their line weight and color.

name: revit_set_line_style
description: Change the line style of detail lines or model lines in the project.

name: revit_get_sketch
description: Get the sketch profile (boundary curves) of a floor, roof, or ceiling element. Returns the curve loops as coordinate arrays.

name: revit_edit_sketch
description: Modify the sketch profile of a floor, roof, or ceiling. Can add lines, remove lines, or move vertices within the sketch.

name: revit_set_sketch_profile
description: Replace the entire sketch profile of a floor, roof, or ceiling with new boundary curves. The new profile must form a closed loop.

name: revit_list_open_documents
description: List all documents currently open in Revit: title, file path, whether it is the active document, and whether it is linked. Use this before any cross-document work to get exact document titles. Works even with no active document.

name: revit_activate_document
description: Make one of the already-open Revit documents the active document, so subsequent tools operate on it. This replaces the manual step of clicking between Project A and Project B in the Revit UI.

name: revit_export_annotations
description: Export annotations (text notes, tags, dimensions) from a view to a neutral JSON transfer file that import_annotations can recreate in another document. Tags carry their host element's identity for re-attachment; dimensions carry their referenced elements.

name: revit_import_annotations
description: Recreate annotations from an export_annotations JSON file in a target view/document. Text notes are recreated exactly. Tags are re-attached to the matching host element (UniqueId first, then category + level + nearest location); hosts that cannot be matched are listed as skipped. Dimensions are recreated only when all referenced elements resolve in the target. Returns created / skipped / failed counts with reasons.

name: revit_transfer_annotations
description: Copy annotations directly between two open, unlinked Revit documents in one step — no linking, no manual focus switching, no intermediate file. Reads text notes, tags and dimensions from the source view and recreates them in the target view. Same fidelity rules as import_annotations: text notes exact, tags re-attached by host matching, dimensions best-effort. The response reports exactly what transferred and what did not, with reasons.

name: revit_undo_last_operation
description: Undo the last MCP operation. Uses Revit's TransactionGroup rollback to revert the most recent change.

name: revit_create_checkpoint
description: Create a named checkpoint (savepoint). All subsequent operations can be rolled back to this point.

name: revit_rollback_to_checkpoint
description: Roll back all changes made since a named checkpoint. Reverts the model to the checkpoint state.

name: revit_post_command
description: Execute a Revit PostableCommand by name. This triggers ribbon commands programmatically (e.g., 'CloseInactiveViews', 'PurgeUnused', 'SwitchTo3DView').

name: revit_list_commands
description: List all available Revit PostableCommand names that can be used with post_command.

name: revit_preview_code
description: Compile C# code WITHOUT executing it. Returns compilation success/errors to validate code before running. Use this to check code safety before send_code_to_revit.

name: revit_set_sun_settings
description: Configure sun position and shadow settings for the active 3D view. Controls sun azimuth, altitude, and shadow on/off.

name: revit_set_visual_style
description: Set the visual/display style of a view (Wireframe, Hidden Line, Shaded, Consistent Colors, Realistic, RayTrace).

name: revit_export_view_image
description: Export the current or specified view as a PNG/JPG image at a given resolution.

name: revit_generate_bim_dashboard
description: Analyse the current Revit model for BEP/MIDP compliance and open the native BIM Compliance Dashboard window inside Revit. Extracts elements from all configured categories, analyses naming conventions, required parameters, and LOD compliance.

name: revit_configure_bep_midp
description: Save or update the BEP/MIDP configuration for the current project. Defines naming conventions, required parameters per category, LOD requirements, and the list of categories to audit.

name: revit_validate_bep_compliance
description: Quick BEP compliance check — returns a text summary without generating the full dashboard. Useful for fast spot-checks on specific categories.

name: revit_get_federation_summary
description: Returns dashboard of host + all links.

name: revit_query_across_links
description: Cross-model element query.

name: revit_get_link_element_details
description: Full parameter dump of a linked element.

name: revit_compare_link_levels
description: Detect level name/elevation mismatches across all models.

name: revit_find_cross_link_spatial_containment
description: Maps linked equipment to host rooms.

name: revit_audit_federated_model_health
description: Audit federated model health.

name: revit_heal_model_issues
description: Heal model issues like unplaced rooms or CAD imports.

name: revit_generate_remediation_report
description: Generate a remediation report.

name: revit_validate_ids_spec
description: Validate IDS spec against model.

name: revit_audit_iso19650_naming
description: Audit ISO19650 naming convention.

name: revit_run_smart_clash_triage
description: Run smart clash triage.

name: revit_export_bcf_issues
description: Export BCF issues.

name: revit_diff_linked_milestones
description: Diff linked milestones.

name: revit_audit_and_clean_family
description: Audit and clean family.

name: revit_enrich_cross_link_cobie
description: Enrich cross link COBie.

name: revit_ai_chat
description: Send a message to Google Gemini AI for Revit-related help. Maintains conversation context.

name: revit_ollama_chat
description: Chat with a local AI (Ollama / Qwen 2.5 7b) acting as a BIM Data Architect. Maintains conversation history. Ollama must be running locally.

name: revit_ai_generate
description: Generate a single AI response without conversation history. Good for one-off questions.

name: revit_ai_generate_code
description: Use AI to generate C# code for the Revit API from a natural language description.

name: revit_ai_analyze_data
description: Use a local AI (Ollama / Qwen 2.5 7b) to analyze Revit element data and provide BIM insights. Analyzes patterns, detects anomalies, suggests optimizations. Ollama must be running locally.

name: revit_ai_analyze_model
description: Use AI to analyze Revit model data and provide insights, issues, and recommendations.

name: revit_ai_clear_history
description: Clear the AI conversation history to start a fresh chat.

name: revit_ai_element_filter
description: Use natural language to filter elements. Describe what you want to find and the system will translate it to Revit filters, e.g. 'all doors wider than 900mm in Level 1'. Returns matching elements with their IDs (use select_elements to highlight them).

name: revit_ai_map_fields
description: Use a local AI (Ollama / Qwen 2.5 7b) to intelligently map Revit element fields to target database headers. Ollama must be running locally (ollama serve).

name: revit_ai_summarize_and_push
description: Ask Ollama (Qwen 2.5 7b) to summarize Revit data (e.g. Room count) and push the result to Google Sheets or Excel. Ollama must be running locally.

name: revit_google_sign_in
description: Sign in with your Google account for AI features. Opens a browser window for authentication.

name: revit_export_to_excel
description: Export Revit elements of a specific category to an Excel (.xlsx) file on your local machine. Creates a formatted spreadsheet with headers, styling, and auto-width columns.

name: revit_export_revit_data
description: Lightweight metadata-only export of Revit elements using batched streaming (100 per cycle). Returns minified data (id, guid, name, category, level, mark, area, typeName, editedBy) without loading full parameters. Supports delta-sync via modifiedAfter. Ideal for large models.

name: revit_compare_snapshots
description: Compare two SQLite snapshots of Revit data to find added, removed, and changed elements. Useful for tracking design changes between sync sessions.

name: revit_delta_sync
description: One-click delta-sync: exports current Revit data, saves to a SQLite snapshot, compares with the previous snapshot, and reports added/removed/changed elements.

name: revit_export_to_sqlite
description: Save a snapshot of Revit elements to a local SQLite database. Each export creates a timestamped snapshot for delta-sync comparison.

name: revit_get_sqlite_snapshots
description: List all saved snapshots for a category in the local SQLite database.

name: revit_import_data_from_csv
description: Import data from a CSV file into Revit element parameters. CSV header row = parameter names. Matches elements by a key parameter (e.g. room Number).

name: revit_google_signin
description: Sign in with Google to connect Google Sheets. Opens a browser window for authentication. After sign-in, you can export/import data to/from your Google Sheets directly.

name: revit_google_sign_out
description: Sign out of your Google account (clears both AI-feature and Google Sheets sessions).

name: revit_auth_status
description: Check the current Google authentication status.

name: revit_list_google_spreadsheets
description: List your Google Sheets spreadsheets. Requires Google sign-in first (revit_google_signin). Returns spreadsheet names, IDs, and last modified times.

name: revit_read_google_sheets
description: Read data from a Google Sheets spreadsheet. Use this to verify synced data or pull external data. Requires GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS_PATH in .env.

name: revit_export_to_google_sheets
description: Push Revit elements to a Google Sheets spreadsheet. Requires GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIALS_PATH in .env (Service Account JSON key).

name: revit_export_to_notion
description: Sync Revit elements to a Notion database. Creates one page per element. Requires NOTION_API_KEY in .env and the database must be shared with your integration.

name: revit_read_notion_database
description: Read pages from a Notion database. Use this to verify synced data or pull external data back. Requires NOTION_API_KEY in .env.

name: revit_export_to_powerbi
description: Export the Revit 3D model with tessellated geometry and all element parameters to Power BI. Default format 'pbit' produces a self-contained dashboard: CSV data files plus a ready-to-open .pbit template with a 3D viewer custom visual embedded and pre-wired — double-click it and Power BI Desktop shows the interactive 3D model with slicers for Category, Level, Family, and every parameter. Format 'sqlite' writes the legacy SQLite database instead (requires an ODBC driver in Power BI).

name: revit_show_powerbi_report
description: Open an interactive Power BI report viewer inside Revit. Two modes: (1) Paste a public 'Publish to Web' URL — no setup needed. (2) Provide workspaceId + reportId for authenticated embedding via Azure AD (requires POWERBI_CLIENT_ID in .env and user sign-in). If no arguments are provided, opens the viewer with the user's saved settings.

name: revit_generate_dynamic_schedule
description: Generate a filtered quantity take-off from natural language and export it to Excel or CSV, e.g. "all doors wider than 900mm in Level 1". Filters compare real parameter values in the requested units (mm/cm/m/ft/in, areas, volumes), looking at both instance and type parameters. For precise control pass structured `filters` instead of (or as well as) the query.

name: revit_place_view_on_sheet
description: Place a view onto a sheet as a viewport.

name: revit_create_viewport
description: Create a viewport on a sheet with specific settings.

name: revit_export_schedule
description: Export a schedule's data as structured text (CSV format).

name: revit_create_legend
description: Create a new legend view in the project.

name: revit_add_revision
description: Add a new revision to the project.

name: revit_print_sheets
description: Print or export selected sheets to PDF.

name: revit_export_dwg
description: Export views or sheets to DWG format.

name: revit_tag_all_in_view
description: Automatically tag all elements of a specific category in the current view.

name: navis_get_model_info
description: Get Navisworks Manage model info: file name, units, model count, saved viewpoint count. Requires Navisworks Manage with BIM-Bot service ON (port 8091).

name: navis_search_items
description: Search the Navisworks model for items whose property value contains searchText (case-insensitive). Returns displayIds like 'p:0/3/12' that navis_select_items, navis_zoom_to_items, navis_hide_items, navis_override_color, navis_get_item_properties and the other displayIds tools accept (valid until models are removed or reloaded). Each search scans every item on the Navisworks UI thread: on large federated models Navisworks freezes for several seconds, so reuse returned displayIds instead of re-searching, and use withinSelection to search only under the current selection.

name: navis_get_selected
description: Get currently selected ModelItems in Navisworks.

name: navis_select_items
description: Select ModelItems in Navisworks by displayIds ('p:...' values from navis_search_items or navis_get_selected).

name: navis_viewpoints_list
description: List saved viewpoints. Each has a 'ref' like 'vp:12' — use it to pick a viewpoint, because names can repeat and many GUIDs are empty.

name: navis_viewpoint_apply
description: Apply a saved viewpoint by ref (e.g. 'vp:12' from navis_viewpoints_list, preferred), name or GUID.

name: navis_viewpoint_save
description: Save the current Navisworks view as a named viewpoint.

name: navis_get_selection_sets
description: List selection sets and search sets in the Navisworks document.

name: navis_connection_status
description: Diagnose the Navisworks connection: checks Navisworks is running, the BIM-Bot plugin is installed, the handshake file, the TCP port and a live ping. Returns a verdict and a fix hint. Safe to call when Navisworks is closed.

name: navis_list_clash_tests
description: List Clash Detective tests in Navisworks Manage (name, GUID, status, clash count).

name: navis_run_clash_test
description: Run a Clash Detective test by name or GUID in Navisworks Manage.

name: navis_get_clash_results
description: Get clash results for a test (up to limit). Each result includes IDs, status, distance, and involved ModelItems.

name: navis_set_clash_status
description: Set status (New/Active/Reviewed/Approved/Resolved) on clash results.

name: navis_export_clash_report
description: Export a clash test report to HTML/XML in Navisworks Manage.

name: navis_append_file
description: Append a model file (NWC/NWD/NWF/RVT/IFC) into the federated Navisworks document. Use after Revit export_to_nwc.

name: navis_export_nwd
description: Save/publish the federated Navisworks document as NWD (or NWF).

name: navis_override_color
description: Apply a temporary color/transparency override to ModelItems (by display ID).

name: navis_hide_items
description: Hide ModelItems (by display ID). Pass unhide=true to unhide.

name: navis_set_view_style
description: Change Navisworks display settings for the current view: render style, lighting and camera projection.

name: navis_set_background
description: Set the Navisworks viewport background: plain (1 color), graduated (top, bottom) or horizon (sky, horizon sky, horizon ground, ground).

name: navis_get_grids
description: List Navisworks grid systems, their levels and the current grid render mode.

name: navis_set_grids
description: Change grids & levels display: active grid system, which levels are shown (render mode) or lock to a level.

name: navis_section
description: Section planes / section box in the current view. action=box fits a section box around items (or min/max); get returns the clipping JSON; set applies raw clipping JSON (edit what get returns for planes); clear turns sectioning off.

name: navis_get_camera
description: Get the current Navisworks camera: position, projection, field of view, model units and full camera JSON.

name: navis_set_camera
description: Move the Navisworks camera: position, look-at target, world up, vertical field of view (radians), projection, or a full camera JSON from navis_get_camera.

name: navis_zoom_to_items
description: Zoom the Navisworks view to fit items (by displayIds or the current selection) and optionally select them.

name: navis_view_preset
description: Orient the Navisworks camera to a standard view of the whole model.

name: navis_timeliner_list_tasks
description: List TimeLiner (4D) tasks with dates, type, status, progress and attached items; also returns available task types.

name: navis_timeliner_add_task
description: Add a TimeLiner task (optionally under a parent task) with dates, type and attached model items/sets.

name: navis_timeliner_update_task
description: Edit a TimeLiner task: rename, change dates/type/progress/costs, or re-attach items.

name: navis_timeliner_delete_task
description: Delete a TimeLiner task (and its child tasks).

name: navis_create_clash_test
description: Create a Clash Detective test from selection/search sets or items, with type and tolerance (model units); optionally run it.

name: navis_update_clash_test
description: Edit an existing clash test: rename, change type/tolerance, or replace selection A/B.

name: navis_delete_clash_test
description: Delete a Clash Detective test and its results.

name: navis_edit_clash_results
description: Assign clash results, set description/approved-by, or add a comment to them.

name: navis_measure
description: Measure in Navisworks: distance between two items (center-to-center plus bounding-box clearance), between two points, or read the user's current Measure-tool result when no args are given.

name: navis_get_redlines
description: Get the redline markups (text, lines, clouds…) on the current Navisworks view as JSON.

name: navis_set_redlines
description: Replace the redlines on the current view with JSON (start from navis_get_redlines output). Optionally save the view + redlines as a viewpoint.

name: navis_add_comment
description: Add a comment to a saved viewpoint, selection set, or clash result.

name: navis_list_comments
description: List comments on a saved viewpoint, selection set, or clash result.

name: navis_create_selection_set
description: Save a static selection set from displayIds or the current selection.

name: navis_create_search_set
description: Create a dynamic search set (Find Items). Conditions are ANDed, e.g. [{category:'Element', property:'Category', operator:'equals', value:'Ducts'}].

name: navis_manage_selection_set
description: Delete, rename, select, or list the items of a selection/search set.

name: navis_get_item_properties
description: Read all property tabs/values of items (Selection Inspector / Properties window).

name: navis_set_user_properties
description: Add or edit user-defined item properties on a custom tab (keeps other keys; a null value deletes a key). remove=true drops the whole tab.

name: navis_execute_code
description: Compile and run a C# method body inside Navisworks (C# 5 syntax, .NET Framework). Variable 'doc' is the active Autodesk.Navisworks.Api.Document; usings for Api, Clash and Timeliner are included. 'return' a value to get it back. Use for anything the other navis_* tools don't cover.

name: navis_capture_view
description: Capture an image of the Navisworks 3D view so you can SEE the model. Optionally apply a saved viewpoint first, or zoom to displayIds (from navis_search_items) first. Use it to check what a clash, section, color override or hide actually looks like. The view stays where it was moved unless restore=true.

name: navis_capture_clash
description: Zoom to one clash result, capture an image with item1 in red and item2 in green, with the rest of the model hidden by default so walls don't block the view (colours and visibility are restored afterwards), and return the image plus both items' details (displayId, name, revitElementId, revitCategory). Get test names from navis_list_clash_tests and clashIds from navis_get_clash_results.

name: navis_export_clash_snapshots
description: Save a red/green, isolated JPEG of every clash in a clash test to a folder, plus clashes.csv (clash, status, distance, both items, image file). About 1 s per image; max 250 images per call — for more, tell the user to use the 'Clash Snapshots' button in Navisworks (Add-ins tab). Default folder: Documents\\BIM-Bot Clash Snapshots\\<test>_<date>.

name: navis_clash_to_revit
description: Take one Navisworks clash, read the Revit Element IDs of both clashing items, work out which Revit document each ID belongs to (IDs are only unique per Revit file), then select the right elements in Revit and zoom to the first. Returns a per-item decision table. Needs Navisworks AND Revit open. Get clashIds from navis_get_clash_results.

name: revit_selection_to_navis
description: Take the elements currently selected in Revit and find, select and zoom to the same elements in Navisworks. Only Navisworks models whose source file matches the active Revit document are searched (Revit IDs are only unique per file). Max 50 elements (the first 50 are used).

name: navis_bridge_status
description: Show the manual BIM-Bot bridge session: the Navisworks master (federated file and its models) and the Revit slaves that joined (slot, document, model). Lists models with no slave yet, so you can tell the user which Revit files to open and join.

name: navis_refresh_models
description: Reload changed model files in Navisworks (like Home > Refresh), e.g. after re-exporting an NWC from Revit. If this Navisworks version does not allow it from a plugin, says so — then click Refresh by hand.

name: navis_recheck_clash
description: Re-run a clash test and report whether one clash is now resolved (status before -> after). Use it after fixing the elements in Revit, re-exporting the NWC and refreshing (navis_refresh_models or Home > Refresh).

name: navis_clash_handoff_table
description: List clashes of a test as Revit element-ID pairs grouped by source-file pair, ready to hand to each discipline (e.g. 'Arch.nwc vs MEP.nwc: 42 clashes'). Optionally also writes a CSV file.

name: navis_ai_chat
description: Send a message to Gemini AI for Navisworks coordination help. Maintains conversation context (separate from Revit ai_chat).

name: navis_ai_analyze_clashes
description: Fetch clash results from Navisworks then ask Gemini to triage them (group, prioritize, suggest owners).

name: navis_ai_generate_plugin_code
description: Use AI to generate C# code for the Navisworks API from a natural language description.

name: navis_dashboard_catalog
description: List the visual types a Power BI dashboard can contain (with their field roles) and every bindable field: 'Table.Column' or 'Table.[Measure]' from Elements, Properties and Clashes. Use before building or editing a dashboard config.

name: navis_dashboard_list
description: List the Power BI dashboards saved for the open Navisworks project (name, created, modified, pages, visuals, last export). The registry is stored next to the NWF/NWD in .bimazim\\.

name: navis_dashboard_get
description: Get one dashboard's full configuration JSON (pages, visuals, 3D viewer settings, export options). Edit it and pass it back to navis_dashboard_update.

name: navis_dashboard_create
description: Create a dashboard definition in the project registry (does not export). template 'default' = Model Overview + Clash Coordination pages with the interactive 3D model, KPI cards, slicers and charts; 'blank' = one page with the 3D viewer and a title. Or pass a full config (see navis_dashboard_catalog).

name: navis_dashboard_update
description: Save an edited dashboard config: overwrite it, or saveAsCopy=true to keep the original and save a new dashboard. Get the current config with navis_dashboard_get first and send the whole object back.

name: navis_dashboard_delete
description: Remove a dashboard from the project registry. Exported .pbit and data files are left on disk.

name: navis_dashboard_export
description: Export a dashboard to Power BI: reads elements, properties, clash results and (optionally) triangulated geometry from the open model, writes CSVs and a .pbit with the interactive 3D model. Update-aware: in live mode, when only the data changed the .pbit is left alone (manual Power BI edits survive — press Refresh); when the layout changed the .pbit is regenerated. Large models can take several minutes.

name: tekla_get_model_info
description: Get the name, path, and connection status of the currently open Tekla Structures model.

name: tekla_get_selected_objects
description: Get the objects currently selected in Tekla Structures (parts, assemblies, bolts, etc.) with their basic properties.

name: tekla_select_by_filter
description: Select objects in the Tekla model matching a class/name/phase filter, optionally scoped to a saved object group filter.

name: tekla_get_part_properties
description: Get detailed properties (profile, material, class, position, user-defined attributes) for one or more parts by GUID.

name: tekla_get_assemblies
description: List assemblies in the model with their main part, sub-assembly count, and assembly position/cast unit numbers.

name: tekla_create_beam
description: Create a straight beam (or column, by passing a vertical start/end) between two points.

name: tekla_create_contour_plate
description: Create a contour (gusset/base) plate from an ordered list of corner points.

name: tekla_move_part
description: Translate one or more parts by a delta vector.

name: tekla_modify_part
description: Modify profile, material, class, name, and/or phase of one or more existing parts.

name: tekla_delete_objects
description: Delete one or more objects by GUID. Irreversible once the model is saved/committed.

name: tekla_run_numbering
description: Run Tekla's numbering (all objects, or only modified objects) to assign/refresh part and assembly marks.

name: tekla_check_interference
description: Run a basic bounding-box interference check across a set of parts (or all parts if none given) — a lightweight clash check that doesn't require Navisworks.

name: tekla_export_ifc
description: Export the current model (or a selection) to IFC using Tekla's built-in IFC exporter.

name: tekla_push_to_trimble_connect
description: Push the current model state to the linked Trimble Connect project so web/mobile viewers see the latest changes. Requires Trimble Connect to be configured for this model.

name: autocad_get_model_info
description: Get the active AutoCAD document's name, units, current layer/space, and drawing extents.

name: autocad_get_drawing_variables
description: Read AutoCAD system (drawing) variables, e.g. DWGNAME, INSUNITS, DIMSCALE.

name: autocad_zoom_extents
description: Zoom the current viewport to the drawing extents.

name: autocad_get_layers
description: List every layer in the drawing with its color index and frozen/locked/off state.

name: autocad_create_layer
description: Create a new layer (no-op if it already exists).

name: autocad_set_layer_properties
description: Change a layer's frozen/locked/off state or color.

name: autocad_get_entities
description: List entities in model space, optionally filtered by layer, with a result limit (default 200).

name: autocad_get_selected_entities
description: Get the entities currently selected (picked) by the user in the AutoCAD editor.

name: autocad_create_line
description: Draw a line in model space from one point to another.

name: autocad_create_circle
description: Draw a circle in model space.

name: autocad_create_polyline
description: Draw a (optionally closed) lightweight polyline through a list of points.

name: autocad_create_text
description: Add a single-line text (DBText) entity.

name: autocad_create_mtext
description: Add a multi-line text (MText) entity, optionally word-wrapped to a given width.

name: autocad_create_hatch
description: Fill a closed polygon boundary with a hatch pattern ("SOLID" by default, or a named pattern like "ANSI31").

name: autocad_create_dimension
description: Create a rotated/aligned linear dimension between two points, with the dimension line offset through a third point.

name: autocad_create_block_reference
description: Insert a reference to an existing block definition at a position.

name: autocad_get_blocks
description: List the named block definitions in this drawing.

name: autocad_move_entity
description: Move an entity (by handle) by a displacement vector.

name: autocad_rotate_entity
description: Rotate an entity (by handle) around a center point.

name: autocad_delete_entities
description: Delete (erase) one or more entities by handle.

name: autocad_get_layouts
description: List the model/paper space layouts in this drawing.

name: autocad_send_command
description: Send a raw AutoCAD command-line string (escape hatch for anything not covered by a dedicated tool), e.g. "_.FILLET".

name: autocad_export_dwg
description: Save the current drawing to a .dwg path.

name: recap_list_point_clouds
description: List ReCap point-cloud entities attached to this AutoCAD drawing (layer, handle, bounding box). ReCap itself has no scripting API of its own — this reads point-cloud attachments through AutoCAD, which is the only way BIM-AZIM can see ReCap data. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for why.

name: autocad_electrical_get_component_tags
description: List electrical component blocks (panels, relays, terminals, etc.) and their attribute values (TAG1/TAG2, DESC1-3, CAT/MFG/RATING1) by reading block attributes directly — AutoCAD Electrical's own automation API (WD_API) isn't used here since it requires a real AutoCAD Electrical install to even reference; this works against the plain BlockReference/attribute data AutoCAD Electrical actually stores underneath, using Autodesk's stock symbol library attribute tag names.

name: autocad_electrical_find_wire_numbers
description: Find wire-number text/mtext entities on a given layer (defaults to "WIRE_NO", Autodesk's stock convention) — a generic text scan rather than AutoCAD Electrical's own wire-numbering engine, since that engine lives in WD_API which isn't available without a real AutoCAD Electrical install.

name: sketchup_get_model_info
description: Get the active SketchUp model's title, file path, units, entity count, and active layer/tag.

name: sketchup_get_entities
description: List entities in the model (top level), optionally filtered by type (e.g. "Face", "Edge", "Group", "ComponentInstance").

name: sketchup_get_selection
description: Get the entities currently selected in the SketchUp editor.

name: sketchup_create_edges
description: Draw connected edges through a list of 3D points.

name: sketchup_create_face
description: Create a planar face from a list of 3+ coplanar 3D points.

name: sketchup_create_group
description: Group entities by id into a new Group (or create an empty group if entityIds is omitted).

name: sketchup_create_component_instance
description: Insert an instance of an existing component definition at a position.

name: sketchup_get_components
description: List component definitions in this model (name + instance count).

name: sketchup_get_layers
description: List layers (shown as "Tags" in the SketchUp UI since 2020) with visibility.

name: sketchup_create_layer
description: Create a new layer/tag.

name: sketchup_get_materials
description: List materials in this model's material library.

name: sketchup_move_entity
description: Translate an entity (by entity id) by a displacement vector.

name: sketchup_delete_entities
description: Erase one or more entities by id.

name: sketchup_get_scenes
description: List the named scenes (pages) in this model.

name: sketchup_zoom_extents
description: Zoom the active view to the model extents.

name: sketchup_export
description: Export the model to a file — extension picks the format (.skp, .dae, .obj, .png, etc.).

name: max_get_scene_info
description: Get the active 3ds Max scene's file name, object count, display units, and current frame.

name: max_get_objects
description: List scene objects, optionally filtered by class name substring (e.g. "Box", "Camera"), with a result limit (default 200).

name: max_get_selection
description: Get the objects currently selected in the 3ds Max viewport.

name: max_create_box
description: Create a parametric Box primitive.

name: max_create_sphere
description: Create a parametric Sphere primitive.

name: max_create_cylinder
description: Create a parametric Cylinder primitive.

name: max_create_line
description: Create a spline shape through a list of 3D points.

name: max_set_object_transform
description: Set an object's position, scale, and/or rotation (Euler degrees) by name.

name: max_delete_objects
description: Delete one or more objects by name.

name: max_get_materials
description: List materials in the scene material library.

name: max_create_standard_material
description: Create a Standard material with a diffuse color (0-255 per channel) and add it to the scene material library.

name: max_assign_material
description: Assign an existing scene material to an object.

name: max_get_layers
description: List layers in the Layer Manager with visibility.

name: max_create_layer
description: Create a new layer.

name: max_get_cameras
description: List camera objects in the scene.

name: max_zoom_extents
description: Zoom all viewports to the scene extents.

name: max_render_to_file
description: Render the active camera/view to an image file.

name: max_export_scene
description: Export the scene to a file — format inferred from extension (.fbx, .obj, and .gltf/.glb via 3ds Max's own built-in glTF exporter, ready to drop into any WebXR/AR viewer or the BIM-AZIM website's AR/VR preview).

name: max_save_scene
description: Save the scene to a .max path (defaults to the currently open file).

name: sap2000_get_model_info
description: Get the name, path, and connection status of the currently open SAP2000 model.

name: sap2000_add_point
description: Add a point (joint) at the given global coordinates.

name: sap2000_add_frame
description: Add a frame object (beam/column/brace) between two points by coordinates.

name: sap2000_delete_objects
description: Delete points and/or frame objects by name.

name: sap2000_define_material
description: Define a material property (steel, concrete, etc.) by name and type.

name: sap2000_define_frame_section
description: Define a frame section property — a rectangular or circular solid section referencing an existing material.

name: sap2000_assign_frame_section
description: Assign a defined frame section property to an existing frame object.

name: sap2000_define_load_pattern
description: Define a load pattern (Dead, Live, Wind, Seismic) by name.

name: sap2000_assign_point_load
description: Assign a concentrated force/moment load to a point under a given load pattern.

name: sap2000_assign_frame_load
description: Assign a uniformly distributed load to a frame object under a given load pattern.

name: sap2000_run_analysis
description: Run the structural analysis on the current model.

name: sap2000_get_joint_displacements
description: Get joint (point) displacement results for a point, optionally scoped to one load case.

name: sap2000_get_frame_forces
description: Get internal frame force/moment results along a frame object, optionally scoped to one load case.

name: sap2000_get_base_reactions
description: Get base reaction totals for the current model, optionally scoped to one load case.

name: sap2000_get_point_list
description: List the names of every point (joint) object in the model.

name: sap2000_get_frame_list
description: List the names of every frame object in the model.

name: sap2000_get_point_coordinates
description: Get the global X/Y/Z coordinates of a point by name.

name: sap2000_assign_point_restraint
description: Assign a support restraint to a point — fully fixed by default, or a specific 6-DOF [UX,UY,UZ,RX,RY,RZ] pattern.

name: sap2000_add_area
description: Add an area object (slab/wall/shell) from an ordered polygon of 3+ points.

name: sap2000_assign_area_load
description: Assign a uniform pressure load to an area object under a given load pattern.

name: sap2000_unlock_model
description: Unlock the model after an analysis run so geometry/load edits are possible again (this invalidates existing results until you re-run the analysis).

name: sap2000_save_file
description: Save the current model, optionally to a new path.

name: sap2000_open_file
description: Open an existing SAP2000 model file (.sdb).

name: etabs_get_model_info
description: Get the name, path, and connection status of the currently open ETABS model.

name: etabs_add_point

name: etabs_add_frame

name: etabs_delete_objects

name: etabs_define_frame_section

name: bimazim_sync_revit_to_structural
description: Push Structural Framing (beams/braces) or Structural Columns geometry from the open Revit model into a structural-analysis engine (SAP2000, ETABS, SAFE, or Robot Structural Analysis) as frames/bars. Returns a mapping table (Revit element ID -> structural engine element name/number) to use later with bimazim_pull_structural_results_to_revit. Needs Revit AND the target engine's bridge both reachable. Section/material names are NOT translated automatically — define the section in the target model first and pass its name via sectionName.

name: bimazim_pull_structural_results_to_revit
description: Read axial force results back from a structural-analysis engine for a set of members (from bimazim_sync_revit_to_structural's mapping output) and write them onto the matching Revit elements as a parameter — that parameter must already exist on those elements (create it as a project parameter in Revit first; this tool only sets values, it doesn't define parameters). Needs Revit AND the source engine's bridge both reachable.
